title: CY E2E s2: multi-hour lazy marks saturation on staked accounts
brief: With stable CY cluster, run 2–6h soak (configurable): periodic touch via Transfer/Stake or account-info-driven checks; assert marks_last_block tracks head and saturation reaches 100% on staked wallets.
acceptance_criteria: Cluster remains up entire SoakHours (default 3; owner may extend to 6).
At least 3 sample accounts: staked_pwm > 0, sampled every SampleIntervalMinutes.
Each sample: pwm account-info (or REST) records marks_stored, marks_effective, marks_sat_pct, marks_last_block, head_height.
Final sample: marks_sat_pct=100 and marks_effective=4294967295 (MARKS_CAP) for all sampled staked accounts OR documented genesis exception.
marks_last_block monotonic non-decreasing per account while head advances.
No seal stall > SealStallMinutes without new sealed height.
Report with time series table + PASS_EVIDENCE lines; log scan summary.

delegation.invite_note:
CY E2E slice 2 — marks saturation soak (hours).

Requires s1 PASS or equivalent stable cluster.

Harness ideas:
- Keep cluster running; loop: sleep SampleInterval; account-info N wallets; append CSV/md report
- Optional: submit low-rate Stake/Transfer to force touch if marks_last_block stalls
- Compare marks_last_block to /v1/status head_height

Owner watches visually per runbook; automation must produce evidence file tmp/cy-e2e-s2-*.

Do NOT require single-node devnet_v5 smoke — use CY RPC.
